meta.source: Lumos SRS-UX-003 / TRS-UX-002 (Midnight Aurora: deep navy/graphite surfaces, violet, aqua, coral and amber accents, restrained gradients). Values chosen and contrast-checked 2026-11-23; proposal pending owner ruling (CR-008).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page behind everything: app background, under the floating navigation layer.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, the chat background. Body text (ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle) passes AA on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus, the safety sheet, incoming chat bubbles' neighbourhood. In light it is white with a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Pressed rows, chips at rest, the composer field. Danger text passes on it (4.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and inputs, focus rings' outer ring. 3:1 or more on canvas, surface and surface-high (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: bios, prompt questions, timestamps beside a name.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, placeholder text, sent and delivered ticks. Still 4.5:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: THE brand colour: primary buttons, selected tab, links, the outgoing bubble's family. Text in violet passes on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons ON a violet fill (6.7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal containers: selected chips, the visibility pill, prompt cards. Ink and violet both pass on it.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Nearby and live: someone is here now, the Bluetooth/Wi-Fi path, nearby-only media. Never used for danger or for brand CTAs.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Interest and the match moment: the 'Interested' action, the match celebration. Kept away from danger controls; always with an icon.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Venues and perks, and gentle caution (not danger): 'only visible to people here', expiring visibility.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Block, report, emergency wipe, failed sends. Always paired with an icon and a word: never colour alone (SRS-NFR-A11Y-005).

tokens.name: read
tokens.usage: The owner's ruling: two blue ticks when read. Only for the read state, on every bubble colour (4.7:1 dark, 4.4:1 light).

tokens.name: tick
tokens.usage: Queued, sent and delivered ticks: the same glyph family, told apart by shape and by their spoken labels, not by colour.

tokens.name: bubble-out
tokens.usage: Messages I sent. Ink and every tick colour pass on it.

tokens.name: bubble-in
tokens.usage: Messages I received.

tokens.name: aurora-start
tokens.usage: First stop of the aurora: used ONLY for the match moment's glow and the brand mark. Never a full-screen wash, never behind text.

tokens.name: aurora-end
tokens.usage: Second stop of the aurora; same restrictions.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs. With Reduce Transparency it becomes opaque canvas.

families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Roboto, "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles at the top of a scroll view (iOS Large Title size). One per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Moments: the match screen, onboarding steps, empty states.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: A person's name on their profile; section heads.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, chat header name, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Are you still at the bookshop café?
styles.usage: Chat messages, bios, prompt answers. Android maps to Body Large 16/24.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Metadata under a row; timestamps in chat.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest allowed text: badges and labels. Nothing in the app is smaller.

spacing.note: A 4-point grid. Screen edge margin is space-4 on phones and space-6 on tablets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tick spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: chips, bubble groups from one sender.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls; between list row text lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge margin on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; sheet padding; tablet edge margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen's primary action; around the match moment.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on Android (48dp); iOS uses 44pt.

radius.note: Soft and friendly. Material 3 Expressive allows larger shape contrast; iOS controls take the system's own shapes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons, the composer's send button container.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, photo tiles, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles (with a 6px tail corner), sheets' top corners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Profile hero photo, the match card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the visibility pill, the floating tab bar.

shadow.note: Dark theme leans on surface steps, not shadows; light theme uses two soft shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar, sheets, the match card.
